correctness.rationale: The proof enumerates exactly the indegree/outdegree defects, including the k=2h balanced overlap correction. The two occurrences of 0^(h-1) exclude any source-to-target path shorter than k-h; appending the target tail constructs such a path for every pair. A completely separate BFS/assignment-DP and literal cyclic-cover checker verified 37 finite parameter triples (not used as infinite proof).

value.rationale: The first nontrivial obstruction to a constrained de Bruijn cycle is a degree imbalance that demands repeated legal windows. The theorem resolves the entire pre-overlap region h<=k<=2h across arbitrary labeled alphabets and run thresholds, gives the exact cyclic test-sequence size and complete optimal bridge decomposition, and identifies the sharp arithmetic correction when k=2h. This is a motivated structural specialization of directed postman optimization, not an arbitrary fixed-size census; no downstream independent consequence is claimed.
